notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): give the CLI and Assistant VS Code's background agent guidance
notes.summary: CLI and Assistant foreground sessions with background tools now get VS Code's background agent guidance, and core gains prompt capabilities to omit image handoff and explicit mode routing.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): publish answered question card before resuming the model turn
notes.summary: Answering an ask_user question in the browser Ask Agent tab now publishes the answered card right away instead of leaving the stale question on screen.

notes.subject: fix(codex): move default and Ask Agent fallback models to GPT-6.x
notes.summary: The default Codex model moves to gpt-6.1-sol, and the browser Ask Agent fallback models become GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): show the working state while a turn resumes after an ask_user answer
notes.summary: The Ask Agent tab now shows the working state while a turn resumes after an ask_user answer instead of looking idle.

notes.subject: fix(tools): surface dropped review findings and predict more git chains
notes.summary: Clean background review results now show the reviewer's prose and an optional limitations list under Not verified, and Git metadata preflight recognises more read-only inspection commands in commit and fetch chains.
